subject: Analog Electronics
questionText:
For the circuit shown below  = 100, VBE = 0.8 V,
IS = 8 × 10–15 A. What is the operating point of the
circuit?
(a)
IC = 18.5 mA, VCE = 0.8 V
(b)
IC = 18.5 mA, VCE = 1.58 V
(c)
IC = 8 × 10–6 mA, VCE = 15.8 V
(d)
I = 18 5 mA V
= 2 58 V
explanation: Practice Question from Analog Electronics DPP-03 (Analog Electronics Practice Sheet 03).
